common.appTagline: Find Korean Supreme Court precedents by fact pattern

home.heroTitle: Describe the facts. We'll find precedent you can actually cite.
home.heroSubtitle: Enter the factual narrative of your case (not keywords). The AI agent finds the most similar Korean Supreme Court precedents and checks whether they would survive citation scrutiny.

intake.title: Case Facts
intake.narrativeLabel: Factual narrative (parties, events, claim, damages, dates)

intake.narrativeHelp: The more specific you are, the more accurate the precedent retrieval.
intake.clarifyHeader: A few questions to narrow the search

results.title: Results
